assumptions.choice: N is 1 prior completed occurrence of the same calendar month
assumptions.reason: The specification refers to N but does not assign it a numeric value; one is the minimum history from which a historical average can be computed.

assumptions.choice: Treat the first observed bar's open as that month's first open
assumptions.reason: The feed begins during May and only the supplied price history is available, so the actual first trading-day open of that month is unavailable.
